enable.name: Enable Video Wallpaper
enable.description: Enable or disable the video wallpaper.

videoPath.name: Video Path
videoPath.description: Path to the selected video wallpaper file (global / all screens).

pauseOnFullscreen.name: Pause on Fullscreen
pauseOnFullscreen.description: Pause when a window is fullscreen or maximized.

pauseIdleSeconds.name: Pause on Idle (seconds)
pauseIdleSeconds.description: Pause after this many seconds of inactivity. 0 = disabled.

scaleMode.name: Scale Mode
scaleMode.description: Video scaling mode: fill, fit, or crop.

enableAudio.name: Enable Audio (legacy)
enableAudio.description: Deprecated. Kept for migration. Use volume instead.

playbackSpeed.name: Playback Speed
playbackSpeed.description: Video playback speed multiplier. 0.5 = half speed, 2.0 = double.

screenVideoPaths.name: Per-Screen Video Paths
screenVideoPaths.description: JSON map of screen name to video path for per-monitor assignment.
